summary.zh: 学期是《剑拔弩张》的中周期时间单位。每个学期由 30 个校园日组成，并会影响年级推进、长期事件触发和长期结局。
summary.en: A semester is the mid-term time unit in Tension Point. Each semester contains 30 school days and affects grade progression, long-term event triggers, and long-term outcomes.

items.zh: 第二学期第 30 天结束后，学期显示会回到第一学期第 1 天。
items.en: After the end of day 30 in the second semester, the semester display returns to Semester 1 Day 1.

items.zh: 右上角游玩天数不会因学期循环而清零，用于记录玩家实际游玩进度。
items.en: The total day counter in the top-right UI does not reset with semesters, so it can track the full playthrough length.

items.zh: 每两个学期结束后，学生年级会在原有基础上提升 1 级。
items.en: After every two semesters, students advance by one grade.

items.zh: 12 年级学生在完成对应周期后会毕业离校。
items.en: Grade 12 students graduate and leave after completing their cycle.

items.zh: 新学年会补充低年级新生，保持校园生态继续运转。
items.en: A new school year brings younger students into the campus ecosystem.
